name: Idea to Committed
description: Takes a rough idea through planning, board capture, implementation, and a commit -- the end-to-end Jenga workflow chain, stopping at the commit rather than at a release.
examples: I have an idea, help me plan it, build it, and commit it
take this feature from a rough idea through to a commit
plan this out, put it on the board, implement it, and commit the work
walk this through planning, implementation, and committing
help me think this through, break it down, build it, and commit
